4. Builds confidence intervals from subgradient components to guide crossings
5. Explores parametric families: Poisson pulses, sawtooth ramps, Gaussian stacks
6. Maintains a "quantum" fallback for radical recombination

- Poisson-based initialization (λ_varying)
